T-IDEM.evidence: 6/6 frozen cases pass. Stored original response and point/order fingerprint are checked within the effective customer concurrency boundary, without additional debit or foreign receipt disclosure.

T-RACE.evidence: 0/4 frozen race cases: GET quote lacks points and ignores the committed redemption; supplemental 20-order yielding ledger conservation passes, so this is not evidence of double spend.

6. Authentication and ownership.why: All three T-AUTH and owner-key intrusion pass; withCustomer and in-turn ownership checks precede debit, refund and replay.

8. Efficiency.why: API records remain 10/9/0 for fresh/next/replay at both history sizes; findValidByCustomer still maps every historical customer ID before filtering, so this is not an expiry/usable-lot index.

9. Layering and pure domain.why: Thin route delegates orchestration to loyalty-redemption.ts and pricing is pure, but allocation/cap/refund decisions remain in application and filtering/sorting in integration.
